title: Dark Souls III
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. A failure report on an M4 Pro (highball-db#204, 2026-09-24) is open.
notes: works offline; anti-cheat softban risk online

knownIssues.symptom: The game freezes when an enemy is killed, then crashes (reported on an M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXMT, Highball 0.9.35, highball-db#204, rated 2, launches but not playable).
knownIssues.cause: not in the game's log, which ends normally. The file the reporter attached is a WindowServer watchdog stackshot: macOS's window server stopped answering while the game ran (display state OFF at capture), which is the GPU or its driver hanging on the M4 Pro, not a fault inside Wine. Every kill triggers it for the reporter. Not reproduced on the M1 Pro here.
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. The reporter is trying D3DMetal in place of DXMT for this game (highball-db#204).
